title: Ada Twist, Scientist
overview: Pint-sized scientist Ada Twist and her two best friends are asking big questions — and working together to discover the truth about everything!

title: Deepa & Anoop
overview: Joined by her color-changing pet elephant, a joyful little girl creates music, merriment and mischief at her Indian family's Mango Manor hotel.

title: Find Me in Paris
overview: When Lena Grisky, a Russian Princess and student at the Paris Opera Ballet School accidentally time travels to present day, she must quickly adapt if she hopes to keep her secret and hide from the dangerous Time Collectors.

title: H2O: Mermaid Adventures
overview: The lives of teenagers Emma, Cleo and Rikki are forever changed when a magical, forbidden island gives them the power to turn into mermaids.

title: Hilda
overview: Fearless, free-spirited Hilda finds new friends, adventure and magical creatures when she leaves her enchanted forest home and journeys to the city.

title: Holly Hobbie
overview: Holly's a 13-year-old singer-songwriter who's got her best friends and close-knit family by her side, but she's dreaming of ways to save the world - even if it's starting in her own backyard.

title: I Woke Up a Vampire
overview: On her 13th birthday, Carmie discovers that she's actually half human, half vampire — and that mythical powers make middle school way more complicated.

title: Julie and the Phantoms
overview: Teenage Julie finds her passion for music and life while helping the Phantoms -- a trio of ghostly guys -- become the band they were never able to be.

title: LEGO Elves: Secrets of Elvendale
overview: Armed with a powerful amulet, a teenage guardian is tasked with protecting her little sister -- and all of Elvendale. Based on the popular web series.

title: Little Witch Academia
overview: When she was a little girl, Atsuko "Akko" Kagari saw a magic show performed by a witch named Shiny Chariot.  From that day on she wanted to be just like her.  Enrolling at Luna Nova Magical Academy and having no magical background, can she become a witch like her idol Shiny Chariot?

title: Luna Petunia
overview: Luna Petunia follows the adventures of a girl who lives in our world and plays in a dreamland where she learns how to make the impossible possible.

title: Luz: The Light of the Heart
overview: Raised by a kind Kaingang family, adventurous young schoolgirl Luz launches a quest with her firefly companion to learn the truth about her roots.

title: Maya and the Three
overview: A spirited princess with the heart of a warrior embarks on a mission to fulfill an ancient prophecy and save humanity from the wrath of vengeful gods.

title: My Little Pony: Make Your Mark
overview: Welcome back to Equestria, where pony magic is everywhere. With friends Zipp, Sunny, Izzy, Pipp and Hitch leading the way, adventure is sure to follow!

title: ONI: Thunder God's Tale
overview: In a mystical world of Japanese gods and spirits, a courageous girl strives to follow in her mysterious father's footsteps and find her true powers.

title: Ridley Jones
overview: Curious kid Ridley and her friends protect the Museum of Natural History’s treasures and keep its magical secret safe: Everything comes alive at night!

title: Scaredy Cats
overview: On Willa Ward’s twelfth birthday, she inherits a beautiful charm necklace that belonged to her mother, who was a witch.  She soon learns 2 bad witches, Wilma and Wanda are after her locket so they can have ultimate power, and she alongside her best friends Scout and Lily turn into cats to escape.

title: Secrets of Summer
overview: A remote Argentine resort revives its wakeboarding competition, drawing in Mexican athlete Steffi, who is determined to uncover a family secret.

title: Surviving Summer
overview: Rebellious Brooklyn teen Summer Torres is sent to live with family friends in the tiny town of Shorehaven on the Great Ocean Road, Victoria, AUS. Despite her best efforts, Summer falls in love with the town, the people and the surf.

title: The Baby-Sitters Club
overview: In this contemporary take on the beloved book series, five best friends launch a baby-sitting business that's big on fun and adventure.

title: Trolls Holiday
overview: When the eternally optimistic Poppy, queen of the Trolls, learns that the Bergens no longer have any holidays on their calendar, she enlists the help of Branch and the rest of the gang on a delightfully quirky mission to fix something that the Bergens don't think is broken.

title: True and the Rainbow Kingdom
overview: When something's wrong in the Rainbow Kingdom, bighearted guardian True and her best friend, Bartleby, are there to grant wishes and save the day.

title: Twelve Forever
overview: Reggie's dream is to be a kid forever. Her dream is so powerful that it creates its own fantasy world of perpetual youth.

title: World of Winx
overview: The Winx travel all over the world searching for talent for WOW. and preventing the mysterious talent thief from kidnapping them.
